title: SyncManager marks every non-definite mirror failure uncertain (sync-manager.ts:143), including the iPhone phone file's plain write error (cloud-adapters.ts:194-195, :225-226), so the mark cannot tell 'may have stored' from 'stored nothing': a trap for the next reader
evidence: Partial 2026-11-27, R6 web follow-up (US-09 AC64, PR PENDING): the log-off check is done. US-09 AC59 (lead H410) moved four readers to the typed reason writes-stopped (error-diagnostics.ts writesStopped); AC64 moves the fifth, the picker's switch stop (standalone/switch-stop.ts switchStopCause, added by AC56 after this survey). Left on the web, each needs a typed field that does not exist, so a design first (orchestrator; R6 health-core half): (1) recordFailure's transport-silence check (error-diagnostics.ts:55-58) reads EXPECTED_NETWORK_ERRORS on the message; no-answer also holds a 5xx read (adapter.ts:113), a corrupt body (local-storage-adapter.ts:97, github.ts:121, webdav.ts:98) and an unavailable token step, a may-have-landed upload with no answer is also silence (adapter.ts:216), chat errors are not StorageErrors, and sentry.ts:230 ignoreErrors needs the same list for raw browser errors, so a typed marker in fetchOrFail and untilAborted would not delete the regex; (2) the refused Drive grant (connect.ts:69 instanceof DriveGrantRefusedError; drive.ts:120-128 names outcome refused and no reason): both files are in held PR 2099, drive.ts also in PR 1788; (3) the busy document write (adapter.ts:157-160 busyWait reads the name BusyError, on purpose across bundles; upload-save-store.ts:88); (4) the corrupt device copy (error-diagnostics.ts:83-92 storageCauseClass reads the cause class SyntaxError for a Sentry tag from a closed list, not a decision). Phone half: done by PR 2115 (PhoneFileAdapter names its outcome). iPhone twin for AC64: none needed (the phone has no web picker). Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 4 (US-10 AC18, PR 2118): the web's readers surveyed; lostAtLoad reads the typed reason, not the status. Left on the web, no typed field carries them: recordFailure's transport-silence check, and the class checks for a refused Drive grant, a corrupt device copy, a log-off refusal and a busy write. Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3b part A (US-10 AC17, PR 2115): every raise site names its outcome; PhoneFileAdapter's read error and refused phoneWrite are 'refused' (Data.write .atomic leaves the old file), its invalid JSON 'no-answer'; the local file adapter's lock, backup, lock-changed and temp-file failures are 'refused' (its own 'Your record was not changed'; a rename that reports a failure stays may-have-landed), so none reads as may-have-landed (pins: file-adapter-outcome-pins.test.ts, ios/engine/phone-outcome.test.ts). R6 PR 3b part B (PR 2116): the outcome argument is required and the status default deleted, so no raise can leave it unnamed. Partial 2026-11-25, R6 PR 3 (US-10 AC16, PR 2108): the mark is now a typed outcome field set where raised; SyncManager marks only a failure whose raiser named none (write-refusal.ts afterWrite). Left (phone half): PhoneFileAdapter's text() and writeText() name their outcome, so its plain write error stops reading as may-have-landed; the local file adapter likewise. Root fix R6 (triage 2026-11-25): every storage failure carries a typed reason set where it is raised. Found in PR 1750 (S69 R2). The failure mirror writes through saveRecordInto (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts:51-52), so SyncManager.save marks any write failure isDefiniteRefusal does not name (sync-manager.ts:143). ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts PhoneFileAdapter throws a plain StorageError(answer.error) for a failed read (:194-195) and a failed phoneWrite (:225-226): no status, no reason, no quota cause. SyncManager marks the phoneWrite failure, and the read inside write() before it, uncertain though Data.write(.atomic) leaves the old file; a read before any write is rethrown unmarked. A mirror catch that read the mark would stop the iPhone's S57 put-back (ios/engine/cloud.test.ts:1185 fails; tried and reverted in PR 1750). PR 1750 read the device copy's revision instead; its follow-up reads the copy's erase epoch (deviceCopyHoldsErase, record-session-mirror.ts), which needs no mark. Candidate fix (option A): a StorageFailureReason in write-refusal.ts's definite table, set by PhoneFileAdapter's text() and writeText().
